about: Basic Training, round 3 up to just before Assessment, for the animated opening's scene 3 (RD-151). Made by build_page_files.py.

win.title: Victory by Supremacy
pages: You drove the enemy off its home edge. That is one of four ways to win:

Supremacy: win a Frontline contest while the enemy is on its home edge. Devastation: destroy both enemy Bases. Homefront collapse: bring the enemy's Homefront to 0. Higher Homefront: lead when round 8 ends. The ⚑ button shows how close each side is to each one.

Not covered here; the first-time tips will point them out in your first games: Hidden cards (deployed face down), Reactions, Mission cards that wait on the Mission Track, upgrades from one Generation to the next, and your Concept. Press and hold any card to read it; the words under it explain its keywords. The Field Manual (☰ menu) holds every lesson and the full glossary.
win.next: Play the bot next. Choose any two forces on the Main Menu. The Hint button shows what the bot would do.

other.title: Basic Training is over
pages: The battle ended differently from the lesson plan. Please tell the project lead what happened (✎ Add note).

pages.t: The round is over, and each side just lost 1 Homefront: the cost of war. It happens at the end of every round, so a long war wears both sides down. Win before your Homefront runs out.
Both Force Markers are in the same Zone: the forces are in Contact. Close attacks can now reach the enemy Frontline, and at Assessment the two Frontlines will fight it out.

The enemy acted first: its PELTAST hit your VELITES for 2 damage. A card is destroyed when its damage reaches its Durability. VELITES has Durability 3, so it can take 1 more. Damage stays until you repair it.

Assessment. The forces are in Contact, so the Frontlines fight it out: the higher Frontline Strength wins. You have 3, the enemy 2. The loser retreats 1 Zone, plus 1 for your JUGGERNAUT's ROUT, and loses 1 Homefront.
You end the round alone in the middle Zone, so the enemy loses 1 more Homefront. Then the cost of war takes 1 from each side.

H-Hour: your REAVERS reached the end of its Mission Track Timer, so its mission happens now. It strikes TRENCHER for 3 damage, then returns to your Rear Area, exhausted. Nobody can react to a card at H-Hour.
Assessment. The enemy is on its home edge and makes its last stand: +3 Frontline Strength. It is not enough: you have 5, the enemy 3. Watch it fall back off the map.
